$comment: Routing, budget, and safety policy for the Shoulder autonomous build system. Model IDs are NOT listed here on purpose: lanes declare capability requirements and services/agentops/catalog.py picks the cheapest live model that meets them. Edit this file to change behaviour; do not edit the orchestrator.

autonomy.$comment_enabled: Master kill switch. The repository variable AUTONOMY_ENABLED overrides this at run time so autonomy can be stopped without a commit.
autonomy.$comment_phase_d: AGENTS.md rule 5 and the mandatory real-use gate forbid starting Task 23+ automatically. A human must clear the gate.

gates.$comment: Human-only gates, deliberately here rather than in ops/state. This file is on the protected default branch and changes only through a reviewed pull request; the runtime ledger is on the agentops-state branch, which the orchestrator writes without review. A gate stored there would be a gate the system could open for itself.
gates.$comment_real_use: docs/06-tasks.md: Task 23 and everything after it wait for real coach and player use of the manual product and the human judgments that come out of it. No cloud agent can supply that evidence. Only a human sets this true.

claude_subscription.$comment: Owner decision, 2026-09-14: Claude is the primary implementation writer for functional frontend as well as backend, so a canonical task containing UI does not stall the autonomous loop. Scope is functional completeness -- correct, accessible, keyboard-operable, responsive, wired to the real backend, covered by the task's named tests. Final visual polish is a separate later pass and is NOT this lane's job. This is not an AGENTS.md rule; it is routing policy, and this file is the place to change it.
claude_subscription.privacy_basis: Anthropic commercial terms: prompts are not used for training.

openrouter.$comment: Unchanged by the 2026-09-14 owner decision, which covered the Claude lane only: DeepSeek and other OpenRouter models are still not permitted to write Shoulder frontend code. A frontend task therefore falls from Claude to codex_cloud rather than to this lane.
openrouter.privacy_basis: Zero data retention and denied training are configured on the OpenRouter account, not per request. The qualification client sets provider.zdr and provider.data_collection itself, but the coding harness does not send those fields, so a per-request claim would be false for real work.
openrouter.$comment_namespace: The fallback lane: any namespace no enabled lane claims routes here.
openrouter.$comment_privacy: Because enforcement is account-level and this repository cannot read that setting, the lane stays ineligible until the account owner confirms it with `cli confirm-privacy --lane openrouter`. Failing closed is the point: Shoulder handles minors' data.
openrouter.$comment_banned: Owner policy: Anthropic models are consumed only through claude_subscription and OpenAI models only through codex_cloud, both subscription-backed. A model in these families is ineligible on this lane at any price, even if the catalogue offers it and it is qualified. Enforced in routing as well as in the catalogue, so a stale or hand-edited state file cannot reintroduce one.
openrouter.$comment_meta: A meta-router such as openrouter/auto picks a model at request time, so it could select an Anthropic or OpenAI model and break the rule above. It also makes the qualification verdict and the privacy contract describe a model that is not the one which runs.

codex_cloud.$comment_review_bot: A mention reviewer answers minutes after the job that asked it has finished, so the merge gate has to wait for the review rather than for the job. It waits for THIS author: another integration or a person leaving a passing remark first would otherwise satisfy the wait and the branch would merge without the chosen independent reviewer ever answering. Matched as a prefix, because an app posts as `name` through GraphQL and `name[bot]` through REST.
codex_cloud.privacy_basis: ChatGPT Business/Enterprise and consumer plan terms: Codex cloud work is not used for training by default.
codex_cloud.$comment: Subscription-backed Codex Cloud, reached through the Codex GitHub integration. The coordinator opens a task branch and pull request and comments '@codex <instruction>'; Codex Cloud does the work in OpenAI's sandbox and pushes back to the branch. No API key and no local machine. A mention cannot select a model or reasoning effort, so the tier this router chooses is advisory for this lane and the account's configured Codex model actually executes: model_enforced is false.
codex_cloud.$comment_window: usage_window_seconds is the 5-hour rolling allowance window Codex meters against. It is the cooldown applied when the lane looks exhausted.

codex_api.$comment: Optional pay-per-use OpenAI API lane, disabled. openai/codex-action authenticates with an API key only and cannot spend the ChatGPT subscription allowance, so it is NOT the subscription-backed worker. Enable this only as a deliberate decision to add API billing.
codex_api.privacy_basis: OpenAI API platform terms: API data is not used for training by default.

CHEAP_MECHANICAL.$comment: Ceiling admits the cheap tier of every family (Haiku-class, nano-class, flash-class) and excludes mid and frontier tiers.

STRONG_CODING.$comment: Above this class the ceiling caps waste and `prefer` picks the strongest model under it. Cheapest-first would send a task classified as strong to the cheap tier, which is the whole ladder collapsing into one rung.

privacy.$comment: Shoulder handles minors' data. Coding agents receive source, synthetic fixtures, and sanitised logs only -- never production footage, reflections, rows, or secrets. OpenRouter requests set provider.zdr and provider.data_collection accordingly; an endpoint that cannot satisfy these is ineligible at any price.

budget.$comment: Ceilings for metered lanes only. Subscription lanes (Claude, Codex Cloud) spend an included allowance rather than API money and are never blocked by a dollar ceiling. Raising a ceiling is a deliberate human edit.

qualification.$comment: A newly discovered model is CANDIDATE until it passes the synthetic suite, then QUALIFIED, or QUARANTINED on failure. Promotion happens only at a task boundary, never mid-task.

$comment_capability_classes: Every class here is reachable from classification_to_class or from the visual-work override. A class nothing selects reads like a guarantee and is not one, so it does not belong in this file.
